about.title: About the GCS Calendar
about.content: Guilford County Schools publishes multiple academic calendars. The Traditional Calendar applies to most district schools, while extended-year schools and some early/middle college programs use separate schedules. Families should confirm which calendar their student's school follows before relying on districtwide dates.
